title: Adventure Comics #487 DC Comics November 1981 Dial H for Hero Andru Giordano
condition_description: Cover bright and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Back cover lightly toned at the edges. See photos.
description:
Adventure Comics #487 (November 1981), DC Comics, presenting Dial "H" for Hero - "the comic YOU create", featuring reader-designed heroes Avatar, Crimson Star, Kismet and Radiator. Ross Andru and Dick Giordano cover. 60c cover price.

Back cover: MPC Turbo Z-28 model car kit ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
